demos.title: Twinkle
demos.summary: Twinkle, twinkle, little star, written as code, one line a note, and shown as sheet music. Each note lights as it sounds, and a star goes up for it. Change the notes and both the tune and the page change.

demos.title: Night Drive
demos.summary: A song plays and its tune and bass are written out as sheet music as it goes: the notes that are sounding light up, a line moves through the bar, and the page turns by itself. Choose which parts to show, or open the song's file and change a note.
